mapper.select: (SELECT inote.incorrect_note_id, p.problem_description, p.choice_1 AS choice1, p.choice_2 AS choice2, p.choice_3 AS choice3, p.choice_4 AS choice4, p.answer, p.category FROM incorrect_note inote JOIN problem p ON inote.problem_id = p.problem_id WHERE inote.member_id = #{memberId} AND inote.problem_type = 'PROBLEM' ) UNION ALL (SELECT inote.incorrect_note_id, u.problem_description, u.choice_1 AS choice1, u.choice_2 AS choice2, u.choice_3 AS choice3, u.choice_4 AS choice4, u.answer, u.category FROM incorrect_note inote JOIN user_problem u ON inote.problem_id = u.user_problem_id WHERE inote.member_id = #{memberId} AND inote.problem_type = 'USER_PROBLEM' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incorrect_note (member_id, problem_id, user_problem_id, problem_type) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{problemId}, #{userProblemId}, #{problemType})
